sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_BATTLE SET ROUND=#round#, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME=SYSDATE() WHERE BATTLE_ID=#battleID#
UPDATE T_BATTLE SET ATTACKER_EXP=#attackerExp#, DEFENDER_EXP=#defenderExp# WHERE BATTLE_ID=#battleID#
UPDATE T_BATTLE SET CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT=#cityDefenseAmount# WHERE BATTLE_ID=#battleID#

UPDATE T_BATTLE SET MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID=#militaryAttackerID#, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID=#militaryDefenderID#, ATTACKER_EXP=#attackerExp#, DEFENDER_EXP=#defenderExp#, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT=#cityDefenseAmount#, STAGE_POSX=#stagePosX#, STAGE_POSY=#stagePosY#, ROUND=#round#, START_TIME=#startTime#, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME=#preRoundFinishTime#, TYPE=#type# WHERE BATTLE_ID=#battleID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT BATTLE_ID AS battleID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID AS militaryAttackerID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID AS militaryDefenderID, ATTACKER_EXP AS attackerExp, DEFENDER_EXP AS defenderExp, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT AS cityDefenseAmount, STAGE_POSX AS stagePosX, STAGE_POSY AS stagePosY, ROUND AS round, START_TIME AS startTime, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME AS preRoundFinishTime, TYPE AS type FROM T_BATTLE WHERE BATTLE_ID=#battleID#

SELECT BATTLE_ID AS battleID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID AS militaryAttackerID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID AS militaryDefenderID, ATTACKER_EXP AS attackerExp, DEFENDER_EXP AS defenderExp, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT AS cityDefenseAmount, STAGE_POSX AS stagePosX, STAGE_POSY AS stagePosY, ROUND AS round, START_TIME AS startTime, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME AS preRoundFinishTime, TYPE AS type FROM T_BATTLE TB WHERE (SELECT CITY_ID FROM T_CITY_MILITARY TCM WHERE TCM.CITY_MILITARY_ID=TB.MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID)=#cityID#

SELECT BATTLE_ID AS battleID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID AS militaryAttackerID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID AS militaryDefenderID, ATTACKER_EXP AS attackerExp, DEFENDER_EXP AS defenderExp, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT AS cityDefenseAmount, STAGE_POSX AS stagePosX, STAGE_POSY AS stagePosY, ROUND AS round, START_TIME AS startTime, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME AS preRoundFinishTime, TYPE AS type FROM T_BATTLE TB WHERE (SELECT CITY_ID FROM T_CITY_MILITARY TCM WHERE TCM.CITY_MILITARY_ID=TB.MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID)=#cityID#

SELECT BATTLE_ID AS battleID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID AS militaryAttackerID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID AS militaryDefenderID, ATTACKER_EXP AS attackerExp, DEFENDER_EXP AS defenderExp, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT AS cityDefenseAmount, STAGE_POSX AS stagePosX, STAGE_POSY AS stagePosY, ROUND AS round, START_TIME AS startTime, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME AS preRoundFinishTime, TYPE AS type, BATTLE_TYPE AS battleType FROM ( SELECT BATTLE_ID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID, ATTACKER_EXP, DEFENDER_EXP, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT, STAGE_POSX, STAGE_POSY, ROUND , START_TIME, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME, TYPE, 1 AS BATTLE_TYPE FROM T_BATTLE TB WHERE (SELECT CITY_ID FROM T_CITY_MILITARY TCM WHERE TCM.CITY_MILITARY_ID=TB.MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID)=#cityID# UNION SELECT BATTLE_ID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID, ATTACKER_EXP, DEFENDER_EXP, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT, STAGE_POSX, STAGE_POSY, ROUND , START_TIME, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME, TYPE, 2 AS BATTLE_TYPE FROM T_BATTLE TB WHERE (SELECT CITY_ID FROM T_CITY_MILITARY TCM WHERE TCM.CITY_MILITARY_ID=TB.MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID)=#cityID# AND TYPE=2 ) T ORDER BY BATTLE_ID DESC

SELECT BATTLE_ID AS battleID, MILITARY_ATTACKER_ID AS militaryAttackerID, MILITARY_DEFENDER_ID AS militaryDefenderID, ATTACKER_EXP AS attackerExp, DEFENDER_EXP AS defenderExp, CITY_DEFENSE_AMOUNT AS cityDefenseAmount, STAGE_POSX AS stagePosX, STAGE_POSY AS stagePosY, ROUND AS round, START_TIME AS startTime, PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME AS preRoundFinishTime, TYPE AS type FROM T_BATTLE WHERE PRE_RND_FINISH_TIME<=SYSDATE() - INTERVAL #roundTime# SECOND
